notes: What a pending server's install progress says when the box goes quiet (2026-11-02, home.serene-parrot: the d-i installer's last checkpoint 'Installing the bootloader' stayed on screen as 'Installing' for an hour after the installer had stopped). d-i's installer telemetry reports at least every 2 minutes while it runs, so a phase 'installing' older than installerQuietAfterMs means the installer has finished (or died): show installerFinished on the current row. Any phase in stuckPhases older than stuckAfterMs means the box stopped reporting before it registered: show stuck on the current row and the stuckAdvice under the checklist. 'installed' (powered off, waiting for the owner), 'pairing', 'live' and 'error' are never judged. quietMs = nowMs - updatedAt (the status's own updatedAt). Identical on iOS, Android and the webapp.

copy.installerFinished: The installer finished. The server is starting and should register in a few minutes.
copy.stuck: This server stopped reporting and hasn't registered. It may be stuck.
copy.stuckAdvice: If it runs in Flagship Studio, look at it there. Otherwise restart the machine. If it still doesn't come up, cancel the order and create the server again.
